records.jp: 今日は時間があるし、<CR>何か教えてあげましょうか
records.en_original: We've got some time today, would you like me to teach you something?
records.en_auxiliary: We've got some time today, would you like me to teach you something?
records.en: We've got some time today,<CR>would you like me to teach you something?

records.jp: えっ、いいの！？<CR>じゃあ、クッキーがいい！
records.en_original: Really?! Teach me how to make cookies!
records.en_auxiliary: Really?! Teach me how to make cookies!
records.en: Really?!<CR>Teach me how to make cookies!

records.jp: それなら、今あるものでなんとかなりそう。<CR>さっそく始めましょう
records.en_original: We should have enough ingredients on hand for that. Let's get to it right away.
records.en_auxiliary: We should have enough ingredients on hand for that. Let's get to it right away.
records.en: We should have enough ingredients on hand for that.<CR>Let's get to it right away.

records.jp: うん！<CR>じゃあ、まずは……
records.en_original: Okay! So, first...
records.en_auxiliary: Okay! So, first...
records.en: Okay!<CR>So, first...

records.jp: 混ぜ合わせる前に、粉を振るおう！
records.en_original: I should sift the flour before mixing everything!
records.en_auxiliary: I should sift the flour before mixing everything!
records.en: Let's sift the flour before mixing everything!

records.jp: 小麦粉をザルにあけて、<CR>ベーキングパウダーも入れて、あとは……
records.en_original: Sift it, then add in some baking powder... After that is...
records.en_auxiliary: Sift it, then add in some baking powder... After that is...
records.en: Put the flour into the sieve,<CR>add the baking powder, and then...

records.jp: 待って、それはデコレーション用の粉砂糖。<CR>クッキーに混ぜちゃダメよ
records.en_original: Wait. That's confectioner's sugar. You can't put that in cookie dough.
records.en_auxiliary: Wait. That's confectioner's sugar. You can't put that in cookie dough.
records.en: Wait. That's confectioner's sugar.<CR>You can't put that in cookie dough.

records.jp: あっ、そうだった！<CR>ごめんなさい、美弦さん
records.en_original: Ah, you're right! Sorry, Mio.
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, you're right! Sorry, Mio.
records.en: Ah, you're right!<CR>Sorry, Mio-san.

records.jp: 謝るほどのことじゃないわ。<CR>ゆっくり確認しながら、進めていきましょう
records.en_original: You don't have to apologize. Just take your time.
records.en_auxiliary: You don't have to apologize. Just take your time.
records.en: It's nothing to apologize for.<CR>Let's proceed slowly and check each step.

records.jp: はぁい。……えへへ。<CR>今日の美弦さん、お料理の先生みたい
records.en_original: Will do. Hehe, you're a great teacher, you know that?
records.en_auxiliary: Will do. Hehe, you're a great teacher, you know that?
records.en: Okay. ...Hehe.<CR>You look like a cooking teacher today, Mio-san.

records.jp: 卵と砂糖を混ぜるところから！
records.en_original: I should mix the eggs and sugar!
records.en_auxiliary: I should mix the eggs and sugar!
records.en: Start by mixing the eggs and sugar!

records.jp: わかったわ。<CR>じゃあ、まずは卵を割って……あ
records.en_original: All right. First break those eggs, and... Oh.
records.en_auxiliary: All right. First break those eggs, and... Oh.
records.en: All right.<CR>Then first, crack the eggs... Ah.

records.jp: わあっ、すごい！<CR>黄身が双子だ！
records.en_original: Wow, it's a double yolk!
records.en_auxiliary: Wow, it's a double yolk!
records.en: Wow, amazing!<CR>It's a double yolk!

records.jp: ……ねえ、美弦さん。<CR>卵を崩すのもったいないなーとか思ってる？
records.en_original: You're totally thinking about how you don't want to break them, aren't you?
records.en_auxiliary: You're totally thinking about how you don't want to break them, aren't you?
records.en: ...Hey, Mio-san.<CR>Are you thinking it would be a shame to break the eggs?

records.jp: ど、どうして分かったの？
records.en_original: H-how did you know?
records.en_auxiliary: H-how did you know?
records.en: H-how did you know?

records.jp: あはは、今のは美弦さんが分かりやすすぎ
records.en_original: Haha, it was written all over your face.
records.en_auxiliary: Haha, it was written all over your face.
records.en: Haha, you were just way too easy to read, Mio-san.

records.jp: ……コホン
records.en_original: ...Ahem.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Ahem.
records.en: ...Ahem.

records.jp: クッキーを作るのだから、<CR>崩さないわけにはいかないでしょう
records.en_original: We don't have much of a choice if we want to make cookies, I suppose.
records.en_auxiliary: We don't have much of a choice if we want to make cookies, I suppose.
records.en: We're making cookies,<CR>so we have no choice but to break them.

records.jp: でも……その前に、写真を撮ってもいいかしら？<CR>ほ、ほら！　陽桜莉にも見せてあげたいから
records.en_original: But... Let's take a picture first. I'd like to show Hiori.
records.en_auxiliary: But... Let's take a picture first. I'd like to show Hiori.
records.en: But... May I take a picture first?<CR>B-because I want to show Hiori too!

records.jp: ふふ、もっちろん！
records.en_original: Hehe, of course!
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, of course!
records.en: Hehe, of course!

records.jp: 材料を順番に混ぜて、生地をまとめて……
records.en_original: Combine all the ingredients in order, then roll the dough...
records.en_auxiliary: Combine all the ingredients in order, then roll the dough...
records.en: Mix the ingredients in order, then bring the dough together...

records.jp: 型抜きも綺麗にできたわね。<CR>じゃあ、オーブンに入れましょう
records.en_original: These are cut quite nicely. Let's get them into the oven.
records.en_auxiliary: These are cut quite nicely. Let's get them into the oven.
records.en: These are cut quite nicely.<CR>Let's get them into the oven.

records.jp: はーい！
records.en_original: Yes, ma'am!
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, ma'am!
records.en: Yes, ma'am!

records.jp: うーん、いい匂いがしてきた！
records.en_original: Yum, they smell really good!
records.en_auxiliary: Yum, they smell really good!
records.en: Yum, they smell really good!

records.jp: そろそろ、デコレーションの準備をしましょうか。<CR>愛央はどんな飾り付けをするの？
records.en_original: Let's get our decorations ready. What would you like to use, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: Let's get our decorations ready. What would you like to use, Ao?
records.en: It's about time to prepare the decorations.<CR>How are you going to decorate yours, Ao?

records.jp: アイシングにしようかな！<CR>美弦さんは？
records.en_original: I'm going to go with icing! How about you?
records.en_auxiliary: I'm going to go with icing! How about you?
records.en: I think I'll use icing!<CR>What about you, Mio-san?

records.jp: 私もそれにしようかしら。<CR>同じものにすれば、いろいろ準備する手間が省けるし
records.en_original: I'll use the same. That way we only have to prepare one.
records.en_auxiliary: I'll use the same. That way we only have to prepare one.
records.en: I think I'll do the same.<CR>If we use the same thing, we'll save the trouble of preparing several different things.

records.jp: えっ、そんなの気にしなくてもいいのに。<CR>準備もお片付けも、私ちゃんと手伝うよ？
records.en_original: You don't have to worry about that. I'm happy to help you get things together and clean up, you know?
records.en_auxiliary: You don't have to worry about that. I'm happy to help you get things together and clean up, you know?
records.en: You don't have to worry about that.<CR>I'm happy to help you get things together and clean up, you know?

records.jp: だから美弦さんも<CR>我慢せずに好きなものを作ろうよ
records.en_original: So go with whatever you want, Mio.
records.en_auxiliary: So go with whatever you want, Mio.
records.en: So you should make what you like too,<CR>Mio-san, without holding back.

records.jp: 愛央……
records.en_original: Ao...
records.en_auxiliary: Ao...
records.en: Ao...

records.jp: ……ごめんなさい、気を使わせたわね。<CR>変な理由を付けなければ良かったわ
records.en_original: You're right, I should just be honest.
records.en_auxiliary: You're right, I should just be honest.
records.en: ...I'm sorry. I made you worry about me.<CR>I shouldn't have attached such a strange reason.

records.jp: 手間がどうこうっていうのは、ただの建前
records.en_original: I made a stupid excuse.
records.en_auxiliary: I made a stupid excuse.
records.en: The part about saving work was only a pretext.

records.jp: 私が、愛央と同じものを作りたいだけなのよ。<CR>……ダメ、かしら
records.en_original: The truth is, I'd like to make my cookies just like yours. ...Is that all right?
records.en_auxiliary: The truth is, I'd like to make my cookies just like yours. ...Is that all right?
records.en: I only want to make the same thing as you, Ao.<CR>...Is that not all right?

records.jp: ダ、ダメなわけないよ！<CR>美弦さんと一緒に作れるなら、嬉しいもん
records.en_original: O-of course it is! I'd love that!
records.en_auxiliary: O-of course it is! I'd love that!
records.en: O-of course it's all right!<CR>I'd be happy if I can make them together with you, Mio-san.

records.jp: チョコで文字を書くつもり！
records.en_original: I want to write things on them in chocolate!
records.en_auxiliary: I want to write things on them in chocolate!
records.en: I want to write things on them in chocolate!

records.jp: あら、いいわね。<CR>私もそれにするわ
records.en_original: That's a wonderful idea. I'll do the same.
records.en_auxiliary: That's a wonderful idea. I'll do the same.
records.en: That's a wonderful idea.<CR>I'll do the same.

records.jp: 美弦さんは、クッキーになんて書くの？
records.en_original: What are you gonna write on yours?
records.en_auxiliary: What are you gonna write on yours?
records.en: What are you going to write on your cookies, Mio-san?

records.jp: そうね……
records.en_original: Hmm, let's see...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm, let's see...
records.en: Hmm, let's see...

records.jp: ……ふふ、やっぱり秘密。<CR>見てのお楽しみってことにしておきましょう
records.en_original: Hehe... I think I'll keep it a surprise.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe... I think I'll keep it a surprise.
records.en: ...Hehe. I think I'll keep it secret after all.<CR>You can look forward to seeing it.

records.jp: ええーっ、教えてよぉ！<CR>美弦さんのけちんぼ！
records.en_original: Aw, come one, tell me! Don't hold out on me like this, Mio!
records.en_auxiliary: Aw, come one, tell me! Don't hold out on me like this, Mio!
records.en: Whaaat? Tell me!<CR>Mio-san, you cheapskate!

records.jp: 後の楽しみが一つ増えると思って、我慢しなさい。<CR>……ね？
records.en_original: I think you'll enjoy it, you just have to be patient. Okay?
records.en_auxiliary: I think you'll enjoy it, you just have to be patient. Okay?
records.en: Think of it as one more thing to look forward to later and be patient.<CR>...All right?

records.jp: ううっ……はぁい
records.en_original: Ugh... Yes, ma'am.
records.en_auxiliary: Ugh... Yes, ma'am.
records.en: Ugh... Yes, ma'am.

records.jp: （美弦さんの『お姉さん力』に逆らえない……）
records.en_original: (I'm no match for Mio's big sister energy...)
records.en_auxiliary: (I'm no match for Mio's big sister energy...)
records.en: (I can't defy Mio-san's 'Onee-san power'...)

records.jp: あら、クッキーが焼き上がったみたい
records.en_original: Ah, the cookies seem to be done.
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, the cookies seem to be done.
records.en: Ah, the cookies seem to be done.

records.jp: やったー！<CR>じゃあ、さっそくデコレーションしよう！
records.en_original: Woohoo! Let's get to decorating!
records.en_auxiliary: Woohoo! Let's get to decorating!
records.en: Woohoo!<CR>Let's get to decorating!

records.jp: ……ふう、完成っ！
records.en_original: Whew. All finished!
records.en_auxiliary: Whew. All finished!
records.en: Whew. All finished!

records.jp: なかなか綺麗にできたんじゃないかしら。<CR>愛央、頑張ったわね
records.en_original: They look great. You did well, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: They look great. You did well, Ao.
records.en: They look great.<CR>You did well, Ao.

records.jp: 美弦さんもね！<CR>……そうだ、ねえ美弦さん
records.en_original: You too, Mio! Oh, by the way...
records.en_auxiliary: You too, Mio! Oh, by the way...
records.en: You too, Mio-san!<CR>Oh, by the way...

records.jp: はい、あーん！
records.en_original: Say, "ahh"!
records.en_auxiliary: Say, "ahh"!
records.en: Say, "ahh"!

records.jp: えっ……え？
records.en_original: Wh-what...?
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-what...?
records.en: Wh-what...?

records.jp: 私の作ったクッキー、美弦さんにも食べてほしいの！<CR>ほらほら、口開けて？　あーん……
records.en_original: I want you to try my cookies! So open up!
records.en_auxiliary: I want you to try my cookies! So open up!
records.en: I want you to try the cookies I made, Mio-san!<CR>Come on, open wide. Say ah...

records.jp: あ、あーん……んっ
records.en_original: A-ahh...
records.en_auxiliary: A-ahh...
records.en: A-ahh...

records.jp: えへへ、おいしい？
records.en_original: Ehehe, how is it?
records.en_auxiliary: Ehehe, how is it?
records.en: Ehehe, how is it?

records.jp: …………ん。<CR>ええ、悪くなかったわ
records.en_original: ...Hm. Yes, they're delicious.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Hm. Yes, they're delicious.
records.en: ...Mm.<CR>Yes, it wasn't bad.

records.jp: 作ったクッキー、１枚交換しよう？
records.en_original: Trade you a cookie for a cookie?
records.en_auxiliary: Trade you a cookie for a cookie?
records.en: Trade you a cookie for a cookie?

records.jp: え？　構わないけれど<CR>一緒に作ったんだから味は同じよ？
records.en_original: Hm? I suppose I don't mind, but we made them together, so wouldn't they taste the same?
records.en_auxiliary: Hm? I suppose I don't mind, but we made them together, so wouldn't they taste the same?
records.en: Hm? I suppose I don't mind,<CR>but we made them together, so wouldn't they taste the same?

records.jp: ぜんぜん同じじゃないよ！<CR>美弦さんのデコったクッキーは特別だもん
records.en_original: They're totally different! The ones you decorated are special, Mio!
records.en_auxiliary: They're totally different! The ones you decorated are special, Mio!
records.en: They're totally different!<CR>The ones you decorated are special, Mio-san!

records.jp: そ、そう……<CR>なら、味見させてあげる
records.en_original: I-is that so... Let's trade then.
records.en_auxiliary: I-is that so... Let's trade then.
records.en: I-is that so...?<CR>Then I'll let you taste it.

records.jp: 食べたら、感想を聞かせてね？
records.en_original: Let me know what you think.
records.en_auxiliary: Let me know what you think.
records.en: Tell me what you think after you eat it, okay?

records.jp: もっちろん！<CR>それじゃ、このままティータイムといきますか！
records.en_original: Sure! Now, time for our tea party!
records.en_auxiliary: Sure! Now, time for our tea party!
records.en: Of course!<CR>Then shall we have tea time right here?

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
